architecture: Four convex coefficients learned as residuals around a known-context-dependent root/body prior; root and articulated prior choices frozen before fitting.
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Select a new controller only when combined validation position+0.1rotation improves on frozen V9 and old-validation position/rotation remain within 2% of V6. Otherwise retain V9. All quality gates unchanged.
notes: Thirty-six candidates, four fixed root/body context priors times three widths times three regularizations.
Same catalog-group cross-fitting and original train/validation/observed-confirmation ownership as V9.
No new downloads and no fresh confirmation claim.
Prior is gated by observed context availability, never clip identity or hidden motion labels.
Zero prior with identical settings must reproduce V9 compact candidates exactly.
Failure on full quality gates prevents promotion into the add-on.
training_objective: Training-only least-squares convex blend targets from cross-fitted base predictions; cohort-weighted kernel regression maps observations to blend strengths.
experiment: Cross-fitted learned corrections around a contextual fallback prior
crossfit_group: CMU catalog subject prefix before underscore; all clips/windows in a group stay in one fold. Catalog labels do not prove actor identity.
fold_assignment: Sorted subject prefixes round-robin across four folds; base training excludes the complete held-out group.
